answer: The ivory multiplier is published, charged in vault, and terrace lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3638 identities would post 4438 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
